concept: The free website review as three pink page flags, rendered in 3D (Blender). One phone on a pale grey sweep showing a made-up firm's ordinary website (Ashgarth Kitchens: Welcome to our website), with three pink flags numbered 1, 2, 3 in marker stuck on its glass, each pointing at one thing: the headline, the wall of small print, the Read more button. Four close shots from the same side. Flag 3 lands: what would we change? Flag 1 at the headline: we'll look at your website. All three down the edge: and send back three things. Flag 3 at the button: free website review, book a call. Pale grey, graphite, navy on the screen and one hot pink.
